title: Spanwit Reclaim-Ops Record v0 (draft)
description: One record from the NDJSON stream emitted by a reclaim-ops script with --format json. Each line of the stream validates against this schema independently. STABILITY: draft. This is an in-repo shape used to validate the scripts' own output; it is deliberately NOT published as a portable contract, and its field set may change while the reclaim binding is still settling. A portable contract is minted only when a second product consumes these records across a tool boundary. Records are discriminated by kind: each kind declares its own closed field set, so a field belonging to another kind is refused just as an unknown field is.

basis.description: How the claim was established. A required check permits mutation only when outcome is pass AND basis is confirmed, so uncertainty fails closed.

volume_unit.description: What observed and expected are counted in.

volume_observed.description: Paths this run was able to evaluate.

volume_expected.description: Paths this run considered. Equal to observed when coverage is complete.

volume_unevaluable.description: Paths that could not be evaluated at all, typically an unreadable subtree. Non-zero forces basis to inferred: a run over a partly unreadable tree cannot describe itself as confirmed.

bytes.description: Apparent size. Not reclaimable space: hard links are counted per directory entry and sparse files report more than they allocate.

method.description: How the population was arrived at. 'enumerated' means every member was listed and the traversal completed; 'declared' means it did not, so the population is a floor.

volume_is_lower_bound.description: True when enumeration did not complete, so expected is a floor rather than a total.

bytes_unmeasured.description: Candidates whose size could not be read. Non-zero makes the byte total a lower bound; a size failure is never recorded as a zero.

skipped_freshened.description: Written to after the plan was taken.

skipped_type_changed.description: Type or link shape changed under us.

skipped_containment.description: Refused on containment or device boundary.
